tasks.short: Learn through professional workshops and meetings

steps.what: Attend workshops and professional meetings about school psychology developments

tasks.design: Protect attendance, discussion and critical learning. Materials stored in {DOCS} remain references; a generated summary is not participation in a professional meeting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Professional learning involves questioning evidence and discussing practical implications.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change removes that learning requirement.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding whether a reported development applies to the children served.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist asks questions grounded in actual school practice.
tasks.altitude: Professional development remains part of the psychologist's week.

reach.task: Discuss the classroom implications of a new approach

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: attendance and critical professional discussion are learning activities rather than replaceable document production.

assumptions: Boundary covers attendance and professional discussion, excluding event booking and later record entry.
No structured learning-completed flag is assumed; participation and understanding remain with the psychologist in s1.
Use existing learning resources before buying tools; current runtime is not human effort saved.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new process is introduced.
unknowns: The balance of workshops and peer meetings
research_questions: Which meeting formats produce changes that the psychologist can explain and apply?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. Attendance and learning retain all their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel children and families about learning and adjustment

steps.what: Counsel children and families through learning conflicts and adjustment problems

tasks.design: Keep counselling with the psychologist. Existing background in {DOCS} may inform the conversation, but this task does not contain a separate documentation baseline to automate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value lies in understanding a child and family through a live relationship.
tasks.enabler_now: No software capability replaces that relationship.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting accounts, distress and changing needs.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist adapts the conversation and recognises when support must change.
tasks.altitude: The psychologist retains counselling responsibility and time.

reach.learn: Share only relevant information with appropriate authority

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: child and family counselling depends on professional judgement, trust and a responsive relationship.

assumptions: Boundary is the counselling encounter; assessment, records and referrals belong to separate duties.
No automatically inferred emotional state, learning diagnosis or agreed-support flag is used; the psychologist establishes meaning in s1.
Review existing tools before adding technology; existing runtime yields no labour saving.
Zero upkeep because the counselling process is unchanged.
research_questions: What proportion of the encounter is direct counselling rather than separately counted paperwork?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0. No counselling or family effort is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Support families and schools during crises

steps.what: Help families and schools deal with separation, loss and other crises

tasks.design: Keep crisis consultation and guidance with the psychologist. A response reference in {DOCS} supports professional recall without deciding what a particular family needs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Crisis support depends on the specific loss, relationships and immediate situation.
tasks.enabler_now: No automation is needed for the core consultation.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing immediate distress, safety concerns and differing family or school expectations.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist responds with empathy and recognises a need for urgent specialist help.
tasks.altitude: The psychologist remains the accountable resource during crises.

reach.learn: Discuss roles and information boundaries during a crisis

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: crisis support requires contextual professional judgement and direct communication.

assumptions: Boundary is consultation as a resource, excluding separately counted counselling, clinical treatment and agency referrals.
The psychologist establishes current circumstances in s1; no structured crisis-severity flag or automated triage is assumed.
Existing crisis references should be checked before adding software; their runtime is not a labour saving.
Zero upkeep because no changed tool or procedure is proposed.
research_questions: Which support responsibilities currently fall between the family, school and specialist services?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross and net=0; direct crisis support and coordination remain human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Refer families to suitable community services

steps.what: Locate community agencies offering the required services
Check service suitability and current referral requirements
Discuss and send the authorised referral with the family

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} keyword search to locate entries in the existing service directory. The psychologist verifies eligibility and current access, discusses the choice and approves the exact information shared; search results never determine suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Contact information can be scattered across local reference documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed search can shorten initial location of a known service category.
tasks.still_hard: Waiting lists, changing eligibility and the family's willingness to engage.
tasks.human_edge: The psychologist judges suitability and explains a referral in context.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less directory navigation; all referral decisions remain with the psychologist.

reach.learn: Verify current intake route and information requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: keyword retrieval can locate existing agency entries, while service suitability and information sharing require human checks.

assumptions: Boundary starts from an identified support need and ends with a referral; agency intake, family participation and prior assessment are outside the denominator and unchanged.

Existing directory owner supplies agency name, service category, coverage, contact route and last-verification date. In s1 the psychologist supplies search terms and checks the entry; its 17.5 retained hours count that work. S2 verifies eligibility and current contact details manually. Missing entries trigger manual enquiry; no structured eligibility flag is assumed.
Test native search before code; only actual manual location work can shrink, never existing runtime.
Allow three focal hours for stale-entry corrections and two coordinator hours for additional directory checking; no transferred work is free.
research_questions: Does search reduce contact-location time without increasing unsuitable referrals?

already_counted.description: Search terms and initial entry checks
Suitability checks and authorised family discussion

incremental.description: Report and correct stale directory entries

approvals.approved_version: Exact referral recipient, route, purpose, family authorisation and disclosed information checked in s3; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=92.5, gross=7.5 and focal net=4.5 after three upkeep hours. Range assumes modest manual directory hunting; suitability checks, family discussion and agency intake do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Preserve direct counselling, crisis support and professional learning; reduce only verified directory hunting.
reach: Clarify referral criteria with community service coordinators
role.ambitious_version: A school psychologist with reliable referral contacts who protects time for children, families and schools.
